subject: Kepler pilot: evidence routing, audit export & key management questions
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna@kepler.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot request + audit/evidence questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team here at Kepler is excited to try Redwood for a short pilot focused on inference for our analytics summarization workflow. Before we start, Security/Product have a couple of hard asks we need to validate: 

- Audit logs: we need the schema (fields captured per request), whether logs are per-tenant or aggregated, and whether we can export in newline-delimited JSON on demand.
- Evidence SLA: if we request historical evidence for a tenant (for an audit), what is your delivery SLA and export format?
- Retention: default retention for hosted, and options for temporary shorter retention windows for PII-limited test data (we may need 7-day windows for some datasets).
- BYOK/KMS: can we bring our own keys? If not for hosted, do you support a temporary escrow workflow for short pilots?
- SSO provisioning: we use Okta SCIM — can you automate user provisioning + SCIM groups for the pilot?

I've attached a short spreadsheet with the team questions (Kepler_audit_questions.xlsx). Can you confirm what you can commit to for a 30-day pilot?

Appreciate a short triage so we can scope the MAP.

Thanks,
Anna Morales
Head of Security Programs
Kepler Analytics

--

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@kepler.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request + audit/evidence questions

Anna — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marcus (product/security infra), Ben (security ops), Karthik (sales lead) and Marissa (legal/compliance) to triage.

High level: we can definitely run a 30-day pilot. There are a few tradeoffs to call out up-front so we scope the MAP correctly:

- Hosted vs Dedicated/Private: full BYOK (customer-managed KMS) requires Private or Dedicated with customer KMS enabled. For short pilots we offer an escrow pattern on hosted but it requires an exception and limited access controls.
- Audit exports: hosted supports on-demand NDJSON exports of request logs and full request/response artifacts; default retention is 90 days but we can configure shorter retention windows for a pilot with Product/Infra approval.
- Evidence SLA: we typically aim for 72 hours for ad-hoc historical exports; faster SLAs are possible as a paid add-on.
- SSO/SCIM: Okta SCIM provisioning is supported for Dedicated/Private immediately; for hosted we can enable SCIM sync for pilot accounts but it needs a short configuration window.

Marcus — can you confirm the exact fields we export in NDJSON and whether we can offer a 7-day retention for a pilot tenant?
Ben — can you confirm evidence export SLA and the operational play for temporary escrow keys?
Marissa/Karthik — I'll coordinate the MAP + a short legal checklist for the exception if we go escrow on hosted.

I'll capture the answers and send a proposed MAP and calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Product Manager, Compliance Integrations
Redwood Inference

--

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request + audit/evidence questions

Thanks Soojin — quick technical breakdown below. Attaching a draft diagram for a temporary-escrow flow (proposed-escrow-flow.drawio).

Audit logs / NDJSON export
- Fields: timestamp, tenant_id, route, model_version, prompt_hash, truncated_prompt (first 2k chars), response_hash, tokens_in, tokens_out, inference_latency_ms, request_metadata (client_id, ip_hash), authorization_context (api_key_id or session_id)
- Per-tenant: logs are partitioned by tenant_id. Hosted aggregates storage across shards but export is filtered per-tenant. No cross-tenant mixing in exports.
- Export format: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), gzipped optional. We support ad-hoc exports via Console + API.

Retention / short windows
- Default hosted retention: 90 days.
- Pilot option: we can set a tenant-specific retention policy down to 7 days for up to 30 days using a retention carveout flag; requires approval from infra and logs ops because of downstream cold-archive behavior.

BYOK / temporary escrow
- Hosted: we do not support customer KMS in shared hosted by default. For pilots we can apply a limited escrow flow: customer provides a short-lived wrapping key (or we escrow a symmetric key in an HSM managed by Redwood with strict access controls). That gives you cryptographic isolation for the pilot data while staying in hosted.
- Dedicated/Private: full KMS integration (customer key ARNs) is supported.
- Caveat: escrow is an exception and creates additional operational checkpoints (key custody approvals, temporary audit log plane).

Evidence SLA
- Standard ad-hoc export SLA: 72 hours (business).
- Pilot commitment: we can target 48 hours for the initial 30-day pilot if we reserve a small ops window and flag the tenant as priority.

Next steps from infra side:
1) If Kepler signs the MAP, infra will provision a pilot tenant and enable the retention carveout flag.
2) We will publish an NDJSON schema reference doc and a sample export.
3) For escrow: legal+security to sign a short key handling addendum; we will run an internal review and produce an access matrix.

Notes: attaching proposed-escrow-flow.drawio.

Marcus Lin
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

--

2) Operational trigger: please confirm the retention carveout window and the expected export cadence (one-time ad-hoc vs weekly scheduled).

Ben Carter

- Audit exports: NDJSON exports available via Console + API; schema and sample will be shared within 24 hours.

- BYOK: temporary escrow flow on hosted will be used for the pilot. Kepler to sign the limited-access/key-handling addendum.
- SSO/SCIM: Okta SCIM can be enabled for the pilot tenant; we'll schedule a 30-minute setup call.
